name: kiro-allspark
description: Documents how the client experiences your service, in natural language, starting from the entry points (frontends and monoliths) and following what each one reaches: connections and the databases each repo uses (roles; HTTP, SOAP, gRPC, Kafka/RabbitMQ, webhooks, S3, detected with a deterministic Python prescan using tree-sitter and validated from both ends), modules (Level 2, consolidated: each one with its endpoints, hops, data access and shared functionalities in a single document). It computes what each entry point reaches and what documenting it costs before spending anything, and positions with deterministic scripts. Renders the universe as an interactive 3D cube with three views: global, modules and detail.
